newsitem.title: USA: Calif. insurance chief to pay $50,000 fine - paper.
newsitem.headline: Calif. insurance chief to pay $50,000 fine - paper.

text.p: The San Diego Union-Tribune said California Insurance commissioner Chuck Quackenbush agreed to pay a $50,000 fine for alleged violations of state disclosure rules during his 1994 campaign.

The settlement was expected to approved by the state's Fair Political Practices Commission on April 9, the paper said. It cited an audit of Quackenbush's campaign financial reports filed during his race against former Sen. Art Torres.
An attorney for Quackenbush indicated the commissioner wanted to resolve rather than fight what he considered to be clerical errors, the paper said.
